punchline: Nietzsche proposed in Lucerne, was refused, and soon after was writing Zarathustra.
thirty_sec: In 1882 Nietzsche fell for Lou Salomé, was refused twice, and saw their planned commune with Paul Rée collapse that October. Biographers report that he then wrote the first part of Zarathustra at Rapallo in about ten days.
question: Which piece of work that belongs only to you could you begin this week?
key_contrast: The loss was real and the work was his own.
